name: Open Interpreter 0.0.43
body:
Open Interpreter 0.0.43

Maintenance release based on upstream Codex rust-v0.154.0. Adds easy choices for Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.7 Flash, Z.AI ZCode and GLM support, and inherited GPT-6 Astra plus GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna presets. Improves ACP harness selection, Chat Completions discovery and completions, Open Interpreter branding, reusable Ollama diagnostics, cross-platform packaging, and release validation. Release packaging now preserves signing when credentials are configured and otherwise publishes explicitly verified unsigned artifacts.
